goal.text: Add dark mode with a toggle, live search filtering, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts (n = new, / = search, ? = help), due-date badges, and fix the overdue-calculation and date-sorting bugs in src/lib/dates.ts.

plan.summary: Seven lane-disjoint tasks: five new features plus the two date bugs, with due-date badges gated on the date fix and the help overlay gated on shortcuts.

tasks.title: Dark mode with a toggle
tasks.goal: Add a dark theme and a toggle in the header that remembers the choice across reloads.
deliverables: src/features/theme/index.ts exports initTheme() and toggles a data-theme attribute
The toggle button lives in the header and persists the choice in localStorage
Dark tokens added to src/ui/styles.css under [data-theme="dark"]
outOfScope: Do not change the light theme's default colours
definitionOfDone: The toggle is reachable by keyboard and has an aria-label

tasks.title: Live search filtering
tasks.goal: Filter the visible todo list as the user types, with a clear button and an empty state.
deliverables: src/features/search/index.ts exports initSearch(store) and mounts an accessible search input
Filtering reuses the store's setQuery/visibleTodos rather than mutating todos
An empty state reads 'No matches'

tasks.title: CSV export
tasks.goal: Export the current todo list as a CSV download with a proper header row and escaped fields.
deliverables: src/features/export/index.ts exports exportCsv(todos) and initExportButton()
Fields containing commas or quotes are escaped
Downloaded filename is sky-todo-YYYY-MM-DD.csv
definitionOfDone: A round-trip test covers commas, quotes and newlines
The button is disabled when the list is empty

tasks.title: Keyboard shortcuts
tasks.goal: Add global shortcuts: n focuses the new-todo input, / focuses search, ? opens help.
deliverables: src/features/shortcuts/index.ts exports initShortcuts()
Shortcuts are ignored while typing in an input or textarea
? opens the help overlay hook exposed by the shortcuts module

tasks.title: Due-date badges
tasks.goal: Show overdue, due-today and upcoming badges next to each todo, using the fixed date helpers.
deliverables: src/features/due-dates/index.ts exports badgeFor(todo) and initDueBadges()
Overdue todos get a red badge, today amber, upcoming slate
Badges re-render when todos change
definitionOfDone: No Date objects are mutated in place

tasks.title: Fix overdue calculation and date sorting
tasks.goal: Fix isOverdue() so it compares calendar days rather than raw timestamps, and sortByDueDate() so undated todos sort last and dates are not mutated.
deliverables: isOverdue() returns true only for dates before today in local time
sortByDueDate() is stable and puts missing dates last
Regression tests added beside src/lib/dates.ts
definitionOfDone: New regression tests fail on the old implementation

tasks.title: Help overlay
tasks.goal: Build the ? help overlay that lists every shortcut and closes on Escape or a backdrop click.
deliverables: src/features/help/index.ts exports initHelpOverlay()
The overlay is a dialog with a focus trap and aria-modal
Opening it via ? works after the shortcuts task merges
definitionOfDone: Escape and backdrop click both close it
